cards.ex: They're throwing a big bash for their anniversary.
cards.exUz: Ular yubileylari uchun katta ziyofat uyushtirishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Katta, hashamatli va qiziqarli bayram yoki ziyofat.

cards.ex: The town's summer festival is a beloved annual affair.
cards.exUz: Shaharning yozgi festivali sevimli yillik tadbirdir.
cards.uzDef: Har yili takrorlanadigan muhim tadbir yoki bayram.

cards.ex: The fireworks display will usher in the New Year.
cards.exUz: Feyerverk namoyishi Yangi yilni boshlab beradi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi davr, mavsum yoki voqeani boshlash.

cards.ex: The parade float was covered in flowers and balloons.
cards.exUz: Parad platformasi gullar va sharlar bilan qoplangan edi.
cards.uzDef: Paradlarda ishtirok etadigan bezatilgan platforma.

cards.ex: The music and decorations created a truly festive atmosphere.
cards.exUz: Musiqa va bezaklar haqiqiy bayramona muhit yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Bayram bilan bog'liq quvonchli va o'zgacha muhit.

cards.ex: We're planning a big family reunion for Thanksgiving.
cards.exUz: Biz Shukrona kuni uchun katta oilaviy uchrashuv rejalashtirmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolarining yig'ilishi, ko'pincha bayram munosabati bilan.

cards.ex: After winning the competition, she was the toast of the town.
cards.exUz: Musobaqada g'alaba qozonganidan so'ng, u shaharning mashhur shaxsiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Bir lahzada katta muvaffaqiyatga erishgan va hamma tomonidan maqtovga sazovor bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: The ceremony will mark the end of the academic year.
cards.exUz: Marosim o'quv yilining yakunini belgilaydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning tugashini nishonlash yoki ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: Our company's anniversary is an annual celebration we all enjoy.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyamizning yilligi - bu biz hammamiz zavqlanadigan yillik bayram.
cards.uzDef: Har yili nishonlanadigan bayram.

cards.ex: The whole neighborhood joined in the street party.
cards.exUz: Butun mahalla ko'cha ziyofatida qatnashdi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'chada o'tkaziladigan katta bayram.

cards.ex: We will commemorate the day with a moment of silence.
cards.exUz: Biz bu kunni bir daqiqa sukut bilan xotirlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror kunni yodga olish va nishonlash.

cards.ex: The festival has deep cultural significance for the region.
cards.exUz: Festival mintaqa uchun chuqur madaniy ahamiyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Biror voqea yoki an'ananing madaniyatdagi muhim o'rni.

cards.ex: The monument was built in remembrance of the soldiers.
cards.exUz: Yodgorlik askarlarning xotirasiga bag'ishlab qurilgan.
cards.uzDef: O'tganlarni eslash va ularga hurmat bajo keltirish.

cards.ex: New Year's Eve is a time to reflect on the past year.
cards.exUz: Yangi yil arafasi - o'tgan yil haqida o'ylash uchun qulay vaqt.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishni eslash va kelajak haqida o'ylash uchun qulay vaqt.

cards.ex: We're planning a party to mark the anniversary of our company.
cards.exUz: Biz kompaniyamizning yubileyini nishonlash uchun ziyofat rejalashtirmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror voqeaning yilligini nishonlash.

cards.ex: I got a little carried away with the decorations.
cards.exUz: Men bezaklar bilan biroz haddan oshib yubordim.
cards.uzDef: His-tuyg'ularga berilib, o'zini nazorat qila olmaslik.

cards.ex: The school always puts on a great show for the holidays.
cards.exUz: Maktab har doim bayramlar uchun ajoyib namoyish tashkil qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Tomoshabinlar uchun spektakl yoki namoyish tashkil etish.

cards.ex: The fireworks display was the highlight of the festival.
cards.exUz: Feyerverk namoyishi festivalning eng muhim qismi edi.
cards.uzDef: Biror voqea yoki bayramning eng yaxshi yoki eng muhim qismi.

cards.ex: Come on, join in the festivities and have some fun!
cards.exUz: Keling, bayramda ishtirok eting va xursandchilik qiling!
cards.uzDef: Bayram tadbirlarida qatnashish va quvonchga sherik bo'lish.

cards.ex: The festival creates a strong sense of community.
cards.exUz: Festival kuchli jamiyat tuyg'usini yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro hamjihatlik va birdamlik hissi.

cards.ex: The concert will pay homage to the great composers.
cards.exUz: Konsert buyuk bastakorlarga hurmat bajo keltiradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishi yoki narsaga chuqur hurmat ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: The award was given in honor of his contributions to science.
cards.exUz: Mukofot uning fanga qo'shgan hissasi sharafiga berildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishining xotirasini ulug'lash yoki hurmatini ko'rsatish maqsadida.

cards.ex: Giving gifts at Christmas is a time-honored custom.
cards.exUz: Rojdestvoda sovg'alar berish - qadimiy odat.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq tarixga ega va qadrlanadigan odat.

cards.ex: The market had a bustling atmosphere during the festival.
cards.exUz: Bozor festival davomida serg'alva muhitga ega edi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar va harakatlar bilan to'la, qiziqarli muhit.

cards.ex: The party will get into full swing around midnight.
cards.exUz: Ziyofat yarim tunda qizg'in pallaga kiradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa to'liq kuch bilan davom etayotgan payt.

cards.ex: Their wedding was a truly joyous occasion.
cards.exUz: Ularning to'yi haqiqatan ham quvonchli voqea edi.
cards.uzDef: Katta quvonch keltiradigan va nishonlanadigan voqea.

cards.ex: Graduation is definitely a reason to celebrate.
cards.exUz: Bitiruv - bu albatta nishonlash uchun sabab.
cards.uzDef: Quvonish va bayram qilish uchun biror sabab.

cards.ex: They pulled out all the stops to make the party unforgettable.
cards.exUz: Ular ziyofatni unutilmas qilish uchun borini berishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga erishish uchun bor kuchni sarflash.

cards.ex: The ceremony will mark the beginning of the new project.
cards.exUz: Marosim yangi loyihaning boshlanishini nishonlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi davr yoki voqeaning boshlanishini nishonlash.

cards.ex: The music really raised our spirits after a long day.
cards.exUz: Musiqa uzoq kundan keyin bizning kayfiyatimizni ko'tardi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir kayfiyatini yaxshilash.
